calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  fs.week_ending_date,
  fs.closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON fs.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON fs.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_key = 30
  AND p.product_key = 11
  AND fs.week_ending_date = '2026-10-04'
